experiment_data.hypothesis: Removing evidence output at inference time should improve RE ign_f1 above 0.5122 (with-evidence baseline) for 1.7B RSFT, indicating an evidence tax where generating evidence hurts relation extraction performance
experiment_data.notes: Evidence tax measurement for 1.7B RSFT s42. Hypothesis rejected: no-evidence ign_f1=0.4352 < with-evidence ign_f1=0.5122, a DECREASE of 7.70pp. Removing evidence hurts 1.7B RE performance — evidence generation acts as beneficial chain-of-thought. Contrast with 14B SFT where evidence tax ≈ 0.03pp (nearly zero). This suggests smaller models rely more on evidence reasoning to achieve good RE. High truncation rate (59.2%) but 97.1% format compliance. No W&B run.
